newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Gudang Garam sees 1997 net at 738 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Gudang Garam sees 1997 net at 738 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesia's largest cigarette maker PT Gudang Garam expects to post a net profit of 738 billion rupiah in 1997 against 655.21 billion rupiah in 1996, Bisnis Indonesia reported on Friday.
The newspaper said Gudang Garam expected to post net sales of 6.85 trillion rupiah in 1997 against 6.56 trillion rupiah in 1996.

"This year we expect to post conservative sales growth as an anticipation of government regulations which would offer more opportunities for small cigarette firms," director Djajusman Surjowijono told reporters.
Surjowijono made the comments following the firm's shareholders meeting in the East Java town of Surabaya on Thursday.
Surjowijono declined to give details of the government regulations which he said would affect the firm's sales this year, Bisnis reported.
Gudang Garam officials were not immediately available for comment. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
